## **Life Story**

Homer William Brewster Jr. was born March 18, 1939, in Morgan County, Tennessee, on the Cumberland Plateau, the son of Homer William Brewster Sr. and Sarah Hazel Kelly. The family called him "Bruce."

In the postwar years he followed the Hillbilly Highway north to Cincinnati and southwest Ohio, part of the great migration out of the coalfields. There he met Judith Mae Palmer. They were seventeen when they ran off to Tennessee to marry; the family gives the date as April 18, 1956\. They settled in the Hamilton and Preble County areas and raised four children. They married and divorced more than once.

The family gives his death as September 27, 2000, in Preble County, Ohio, at sixty-one. A Dayton Daily News obituary two days later is indexed, though its text has not been read yet.

More of Homer's story is in the couple profile. It will be added here once the family members who shared it approve it.

Death: 1991 was his father's SSDI year, so 2000 stands. An Ohio death certificate (Preble County, 2000\) or the Dayton Daily News obituary (29 Sep 2000, p. B6) would prove it.

No marriage record found yet for the later remarriages.

No military record found; he was of draft age in the Vietnam era.
